Order per the bars: findings files first, then register, then one final claimlint run.

Judgment: the mirror measurement (0 new-engine throw-aways in 56 losses; 0 self-contradictions in 56/56 in-scope first-divergence loss nodes against the new table's own L/H bracket; null + seeded controls) is a falsifiable, denominator-carrying, controlled measurement about the new table's bracket-vs-own-play consistency — the missing half of landmark L3 (the new engine outplays the old one). It is a candidate register claim; proposing is correct per the brief; promoting is the Orchestrator's. The proposal enters the absorption queue (C7 unabsorbed findings 0->1, below the STANDING-ABSORB threshold of 5).

trigger_gap_finding.mechanism: bin/managent standing reads the STANDING-ABSORB trigger from the marker's own line (C7 unabsorbed: <n> (threshold 5) — no trigger). That count comes from weizigo-claimlint's C7 'unabsorbed findings' counter, which counts claims parsed from findings/*.json. A findings file that does not parse (invalid JSON, missing required keys) contributes NOTHING to the counter — C7 non-conforming files is a separate, REPORTED line that the marker does not read. So five unparseable findings files read as 'C7 unabsorbed: 0 — no trigger': the trigger counts what it can read and is blind to what it cannot. That is backwards: a file that will not parse is a stronger reason to absorb (its content is invisible) than one that will (its content is at least in the queue).
trigger_gap_finding.observed: Before this row: C7 unabsorbed findings 0 (threshold 5, no trigger) while 5 files were non-conforming. After repairs: C7 non-conforming 5->0; C7 unabsorbed findings 1 (the T375 proposal) — still below threshold 5, still no trigger, but the count now reflects the queue honestly.
trigger_gap_finding.disposition: Not fixed in this row per the brief: T368 has just rewired the standing-trigger markers and the fix belongs in one place. Filed for the next set-C row: the absorb trigger should also read C7 non-conforming files (or the marker should fold non-conforming files into the unabsorbed count), so an unparseable findings file reads as a stronger, not weaker, reason to absorb.
trigger_gap_finding.known_good_remaining: C7 unabsorbed findings 1 is the intended consequence of the T375 proposal entering the queue; no other counter moved (C1a=10, C1b=0, C2=14, C6=0, C9=0, calibration PASS before and after).
